The '''Dulvoyinn system''' was a part of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Dulvoyinn bloodcat]]s.<ref name="Journal9" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dulvoyinn [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA" />
